id.description: Registry key; equals core.app.id and the directory name under apps/toolbelt/apps/.

kind.description: ui: Shell-routed web surface. cli: operator-invoked command. headless: no human surface (see 3.3). hybrid: ui plus cli.

version.description: Semver of the manifest's tool; bumped on any contract-visible change.

path.description: apps/toolbelt(/apps/<id>) for a real Toolbelt tool. services/<id> is the one documented exception (08-llm-handlers.md forced decision 7): a platform service that registers in the same core.app registry as every Toolbelt tool without living inside the Toolbelt tree.

dist.description: Build output dir relative to the tool root; omitted for tools rendered by Shell pages

schedule.description: cron expression when the tool is timer-driven; absent for event-driven

schemas.description: Database schemas this tool OWNS (writes DDL for). Exactly one writer per schema across all manifests; the validator enforces global uniqueness except for the root spine's core/idea ownership.

read.description: Schemas this tool may read, including schemas owned by another manifest.

write.description: Schemas this tool may write. Every entry must be owned by this same manifest.

networkEgress.description: Exact hosts the tool contacts beyond the platform Supabase project. Empty array means no egress.

vaultKeys.description: Names (never values) of third-party credentials this tool needs injected via the guards broker (Epic #182). Optional and empty by default -- a tool declares a key here only once it actually calls the broker for it (see issue #186's llm-handler migration); an absent or empty array means the broker grants this caller no credentials at all.

access.description: Whether the tool may call the general-purpose LLM handler via packages/llm. Never grants Brain key access; see ADR-05.

migrate.description: Command applying this tool's supabase/migrations, or 'none' for schema-less tools

health.description: Command or URL path that exits 0 / returns 200 when the tool is healthy (system-wide observability rule, 03-v1-definition.md)

register.description: Path of the generated registration migration relative to apps/toolbelt/supabase/migrations/
